infrastructureCaveat: Chopsticks eth_getStorageAt uses H256 encoding for runtime U256 slot index; implementation slots read from native EVM.AccountStorages instead.

buy(address,address,uint256,uint256,byte.details: Two modes (see `sell`): empty `dispatchData` → build      `route_executor.buy(assetId[tokenIn], assetId[tokenOut], amountOut, maxAmountIn, [])`      with an EMPTY route; non-empty → patch amounts into the caller-supplied call.⚠️ Param order here is `(maxAmountIn, amountOut)` — the debt-swap adapter      convention, and the REVERSE of Propeller's `ISwapper.buy(…, amountOut, maxIn, …)`,      which shares the same 4-arg selector. Propeller only ever calls `sell()`      (verified: `CollateralVault.compound` is the sole swapper caller), so this      divergence is intentional. Do NOT route Propeller's `buy` here via the ISwapper      cast without first aligning the two uint256 args, or they will be swapped silently.

params.amountOut: The exact amount of `tokenOut` desired (must fit u128).
params.dispatchData: Empty to build from the asset-id map, or a SCALE-encoded        `route_executor.buy` call whose amounts are patched.
params.maxAmountIn: The maximum amount of `tokenIn` willing to spend (must fit u128).

sell(address,address,uint256,uint256,byt.details: Two modes:      - empty `dispatchData` → build `route_executor.sell(assetId[tokenIn],        assetId[tokenOut], amountIn, minAmountOut, [])` with an EMPTY route, so the        router uses its governance-set on-chain route (keeper path);      - non-empty `dispatchData` → treat it as a caller-supplied SCALE call and patch        the amounts at offsets [10..26)/[26..42) (frontend / debt-swap path).

params.amountIn: The exact amount of `tokenIn` to sell (must fit u128).
params.dispatchData: Empty to build from the asset-id map, or a SCALE-encoded        `route_executor.sell` call whose amounts are patched.
params.minAmountOut: The minimum acceptable amount of `tokenOut` (must fit u128).

setAssetId(address,uint32).details: Consumed by the empty-`dispatchData` path in `sell`/`buy`. A token must be      registered here (non-zero id) to swap via that path, so HDX (asset 0) is not      reachable this way — pass explicit `dispatchData` for it. The route is resolved      by the on-chain router, not stored here.

params.id: The substrate asset id used inside the SCALE call.

assetId(address).notice: EVM token address → Hydration substrate asset id (governance-set).

buy(address,address,uint256,uint256,byte.notice: Execute an exact-output swap via the substrate route executor.

owner().notice: Governance owner permitted to configure asset ids and routes.

sell(address,address,uint256,uint256,byt.notice: Execute an exact-input swap via the substrate route executor.

setAssetId(address,uint32).notice: Map an EVM token address to its Hydration substrate asset id.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Transfer governance ownership (e.g. deployer → Hydration governance).
